problem: The investigation finished its fits but could not be saved: an identifiability value (an unbounded local uncertainty or condition number) was infinite and JSON storage refuses non-finite numbers.
fix: Non-finite numbers are stored as null (api.finite) and the condition number is null when undefined. Fit logic, thresholds and fixtures unchanged.
effect: Both cases now complete; their results come from the re-run.

problem: The verdict 'No change needed' described only the compared impulse; the precursor before the entered onset was flagged on the front and tail metrics ('Requires review') but not repeated next to the verdict.
fix: When the comparison carries rising-limb review flags or metrics marked 'Requires review', the verdict now states 'Requires review' and why. The verdict label and every threshold are unchanged.
effect: Wording only; no gate outcome changes.

cases: L 80 uH, front x0.25 (ringing in model)
